seoTitle: Caffeine Intake Calculator (Daily Total vs 400 mg)
metaDescription: Add up the coffee, tea, cola and energy drinks you had and compare the range with the 400 mg a day FDA figure for healthy adults.
intro: Add up your caffeine and compare it with 400 mg a day.
why:
Type your drinks one per line, such as coffee 2 or energy drink 1, or give an exact amount like mg 80 2. The page shows a low and high total using the FDA ranges per 12 fl oz serving and compares it with the 400 mg a day figure the FDA gives for most healthy adults.

A small espresso, a big mug or a branded energy drink will differ from these averages, so read the can. Sensitivity varies a lot. If you are pregnant, breastfeeding, have a heart condition or take medication, ask a health professional for your own limit.
howTo: Type one drink and count per line.
Use mg lines for labelled products.
Read the low and high total.
Compare it with the 400 mg figure.

faq.q: Where do the amounts come from?
faq.a: From the FDA page on caffeine for a 12 fl oz serving: coffee 113 to 247 mg, black tea 71, green tea 37, cola 23 to 83, energy drinks 41 to 246.

faq.q: Is 400 mg a limit for everyone?
faq.a: No. It is a figure for most healthy adults. Children, pregnancy and some conditions call for less.
No. It is an estimate from a published formula. A doctor or dietitian can judge your own case far better.
